_comment: Stable prod fixtures the probe reads (never writes). All owned by the test
account behind ~/.tetapi/test_api_key. If a fixture disappears the dependent
check reports SKIP with the reason, never a fake PASS.
s8: entity created by session 15.3 (2026-08-05) with one public and one private
block, left in place precisely as the S-8 regression fixture. The private block's
title is 'private-block-s8-SECRET' — the id being public is fine, the API must
never return the row to a non-owner. Since S-17 (2026-09-14) the entity itself
MUST be public (is_public=is_published=true), otherwise /blocks 404s and the
s17: a private (is_public=false, is_published=false) entity of the same test
account; every by-UUID read (base/preview/proof/blocks) must 404 anonymously
s21: one Pi CAM device of the same test account, paired then REVOKED on prod
(2026-09-20, api PR #29 live check — the one justified prod write, see README).
The key is stored WITHOUT its pk_live_ prefix; it is worthless by construction
(server erased it, api_key IS NULL). device-upload with it must 401 and the
owner's GET /devices must still list the device with revoked_at set.
